The  job  market  of  the  future  is  going  to 
 be  BYOS,  which  is  bring  your  own 
 software  or  bring  your  own  agent.  And 
 so,  what  that  means  is  you're  going  to 
 train  agents  on  doing  what  you  do,  so 
 that  you  can  go  to  a  business  and  say, 
 "Hey,  instead  of  hiring  a  department, 
 you  can  just  bring  me  and  I  can  do  all 
 of  it.  And  instead  of  compensating  an 
 entire  department,  I  would  like  some 
 fraction  between  what  you  would  pay  one 
 person  and  what  you  pay  that  entire 
 department."  It's  a  win-win  proposition 
 that  I  think  people  who  are  paying 
 attention  to  AI  right  now  and  not  afraid 
 of  it,  but  leading  into  it.  So,  that  the 
 goal  is  that  you  replace  yourself  and 
 don't  let  someone  else  do  it.
